# cli


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

Installing litesearch adds a `litesearch` command. It has one
subcommand,
[`install`](https://Karthik777.github.io/litesearch/cli.html#install),
which copies the `SKILL.md` file bundled with the package into a project
so that coding agents find it. The file describes litesearch’s API for
an agent such as Claude Code or Codex. It is written to three places
under the target folder: `.agents/skills/litesearch/`,
`.claude/skills/litesearch/` and `.Codex/skills/litesearch/`.

``` sh
litesearch install                 # into the current git repository's root, or the current folder outside one
litesearch install --dir ~/myapp   # into another folder
```

Running `litesearch` with no subcommand, or an unknown one, prints the
list of commands and exits.
